component.name: Moji Plus
component.summary: Clean Markdown viewer and editor, based on Moji

description.p: Moji Plus opens, previews, edits, and exports Markdown files in a compact desktop workspace.
It is a derivative of Moji by Alex Ishida (https://github.com/alexishida/Moji), distributed under the MIT License, and keeps receiving the changes made to the original project.
It supports split preview and editing, outline navigation, search and replace, localized UI, and export to PDF, HTML, and PNG.

ul.li: Open documents changed or removed by other applications are detected, and saving never overwrites such a change without asking.
The last session reopens: tabs in order, unsaved changes to files, view mode, outline, full width, maximized window and each document's reading position.
Undoing every edit clears the unsaved-changes mark.
Closing an untitled document with content asks whether to save it.
The status bar token count is shown as an estimate.
Select All in the preview selects only the document.
Local images in HTML img tags load in the preview and in exports.
The About panel scrolls in small windows.
macOS now checks for a newer Moji Plus, like Windows and Linux.
On Windows and Linux, scrollbars stay hidden until you scroll or hover over them, like on macOS.
PDF export prints white page margins instead of dark ones.

description.p: First Moji Plus release, based on Moji 1.0.7.

ul.li: Light and dark themes for the whole app, following the OS theme by default.
YAML front matter rendered as a highlighted code block in the preview and exports.
No native title bar: the top bar fills the top of the window with the native window controls.
Own name, icon, settings directory, and releases, so it installs next to the original Moji.
